Substations | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 on GIS circuit 
breaker 220 kv, which must be performed on monthly bases as indicted by M1 in 
the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Kamal Oshba, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector 
of Damanhour power station, and 
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia Diab WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required..
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, and safety glasses.
Tools and Equipment
Electrical tool kit.
Work to be carried out
Check gas pressure 
for all equipments and record.
Check the 
anticondensation resistance.
Check the compressor oil.
Make sure the condensate 
drain valve is in good operation.
Take the number of 
operations for CB and record.
